items.summary: CTO disposition: preserve containment. Do not admit new implementation, telemetry, schedule, access, dependency, spend, or site-factory work while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z with root-cause or closure evidence, deterministic tests, isolated validation, build evidence, rollback point, release boundary, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Release a slot only after that evidence is recorded; otherwise escalate to the owner.

Retain the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the sole next implementation after capacity clears. Scope is limited to CTA hierarchy, existing destinations and disclosure, keyboard focus, contrast, tap targets, responsive behavior, deterministic validation, build, link validation, and smoke testing. Use a single-diff rollback. Measure only the existing site-level registered affiliate-click telemetry for 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions or clicks; surface-level lift, revenue, conversion, ROI, and causal lift are unknown because no surface-specific telemetry is evidenced.

Correct the launch-readiness handoff: readiness packets are bounded report-only evidence work and do not occupy implementation slots or authorize production launch. Keep preview-only dispositions, analytics and affiliate setup, public exposure, domain changes, dependencies, spend, and deployment gated until the existing legal, compliance, security, measurement, owner, and rollback evidence is complete.

Keep the routed SEO candidates capacity-gated and non-duplicative. Admit at most one only after a slot is released and existing queue state is reconciled. Acceptance must use the existing GSC baseline, verify indexability, canonical and sitemap behavior, internal-link resolution, absence of new broken links, deterministic build checks, and a declared rollback point. Do not request duplicate telemetry or claim revenue, conversion, or causal lift.

Maintain all private-launch and security-sensitive release gates. Existing evidence does not establish authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS controls, monitoring, or incident readiness. Continue authorized read-only evidence work only; do not clear gates, retrieve credentials, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
